The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

stories.headline: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
stories.what_happened: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.
